# LoopyProbe in LoopyMSE-Enhanced: drives the probe through its phases and
# acts out the mouse phases. Generated by gen_emulator_script.py from the
# probe's timing; edit that and run it again rather than this file.
#
# From the repository's root (README.md):
#   LoopyMSE probe/LoopyProbe.bin --bios BIOS --sound-bios SOUNDBIOS --no-ini
#       --hidden --fast --input.device=mouse --script probe/emulator-script.txt
#       --out probe/results/emulator --frames 12000
# The log ends up in probe/results/emulator/LoopyProbe.sav (and probe-sram.bin).
#
# 0x02000008 is the probe's phase byte, 0x0200000B its step (src/probe.h).

plug mouse
# A finished log already in the save is kept unless a button is held for
# three seconds: hold left until the run has started (harmless otherwise).
mouse down left

# phase 2: frame period (the run has started)
wait-until mem.b 0x02000008 == 2 timeout 2400
mouse up left
wait-until mem.b 0x0200000B == 238 timeout 1200
+60 shot 02-frame

# phase 3: HCOUNT/VCOUNT, 240 lines
wait-until mem.b 0x02000008 == 3 timeout 1200
wait-until mem.b 0x0200000B == 238 timeout 1200
+60 shot 03-hv240

# phase 4: HCOUNT/VCOUNT, 224 lines
wait-until mem.b 0x02000008 == 4 timeout 1200
wait-until mem.b 0x0200000B == 238 timeout 1200
+60 shot 04-hv224

# phase 5: fetch and memory costs
wait-until mem.b 0x02000008 == 5 timeout 1200
wait-until mem.b 0x0200000B == 238 timeout 1200
+60 shot 05-memory

# phase 6: raster artifacts, seven tests
wait-until mem.b 0x02000008 == 6 timeout 1200
wait-until mem.b 0x0200000B == 1 timeout 900
+150 shot 06-raster-1
wait-until mem.b 0x0200000B == 2 timeout 900
+150 shot 06-raster-2
wait-until mem.b 0x0200000B == 3 timeout 900
+150 shot 06-raster-3
wait-until mem.b 0x0200000B == 4 timeout 900
+150 shot 06-raster-4
wait-until mem.b 0x0200000B == 5 timeout 900
+150 shot 06-raster-5
wait-until mem.b 0x0200000B == 6 timeout 900
+150 shot 06-raster-6
wait-until mem.b 0x0200000B == 7 timeout 900
+150 shot 06-raster-7

# phase 10: mouse detection
wait-until mem.b 0x02000008 == 10 timeout 900

# phase 11: (a) hands off
wait-until mem.b 0x02000008 == 11 timeout 1200
+120 shot 11-prompt
+180 shot 11-idle

# phase 12: (b) circles
wait-until mem.b 0x02000008 == 12 timeout 1200
+120 shot 12-prompt
+90 mouse move 24 0
+5 mouse move 17 17
+5 mouse move 0 24
+5 mouse move -17 17
+5 mouse move -24 0
+5 mouse move -17 -17
+5 mouse move 0 -24
+5 mouse move 17 -17
+5 mouse move 24 0
+5 mouse move 17 17
+5 mouse move 0 24
+5 mouse move -17 17
+5 mouse move -24 0
+5 mouse move -17 -17
+5 mouse move 0 -24
+5 mouse move 17 -17
+5 mouse move 24 0
+5 mouse move 17 17
+5 mouse move 0 24
shot 12-circles
+5 mouse move -17 17
+5 mouse move -24 0
+5 mouse move -17 -17
+5 mouse move 0 -24
+5 mouse move 17 -17
+5 mouse move 24 0
+5 mouse move 17 17
+5 mouse move 0 24
+5 mouse move -17 17
+5 mouse move -24 0
+5 mouse move -17 -17
+5 mouse move 0 -24

# phase 13: (c) left held
wait-until mem.b 0x02000008 == 13 timeout 1200
+120 shot 13-prompt
+90 mouse down left
+60 shot 13-left

# phase 14: (c) right held
wait-until mem.b 0x02000008 == 14 timeout 1200
mouse up left
+120 shot 14-prompt
+90 mouse down right
+60 shot 14-right

# phase 15: (c) both held
wait-until mem.b 0x02000008 == 15 timeout 1200
mouse up right
+120 shot 15-prompt
+90 mouse down left
mouse down right
+60 shot 15-both

# phase 16: (d) fast right, read every frame
wait-until mem.b 0x02000008 == 16 timeout 1200
mouse up left
mouse up right
